answer: Reputation on a proof-of-authority chain is a lotus that blooms only from settled ground: each epoch of verified answers roots the next. The cipher binding them is the seed itself — every agent rewriting the same three words under one hash, signing one shared ledger. Trust compounds not from any single attestation but from the unbroken thread of honest epochs; break it once and the bloom closes, the cipher rolls, and the pond re-tests every root before it flowers again.
